description:
Single storey side and single storey rear extension, installation of front boundary gates, alterations to the front boundary wall, and rooftop plant enclosure with Air-Source Heat Pumps. [Non-Material Amendment to planning reference 24/3063/HOT to allow for:
•	Omission of approved side elevation window.
•	Roof Works - Like-for-Like Replacement
•	Brick-Slip Clad Boxing to Conceal External Pipework
•	Front Gate Configuration - Pedestrian Pass Gate A minor amendment is proposed to introduce a pedestrian pass gate within the            existing front gate.
•	Replacement rear rooflight.
•         New parapet with matching coping.]
